title: The Little Raid: items you can tell apart
lines: In The Little Raid, each component has its own colour and shape.
A finished item has a frame in the colours of the two components it is made of.

more.head: Also
points: Components are drawn bigger, with more detail.
Ten finished items have new pictures.
An emblem has a frame in its trait's colour.
Over a figure, a finished item is a square of its two colours with a gold edge.
The Carving Knife has a new picture. Two Knives make An Extra Chair, which has a cream frame.
